items.title: T Mobile US (TMUS) Rolls Out Nationwide AI Powered Network Automation
items.summary: T-Mobile US (NasdaqGS:TMUS) introduced nationwide AI-powered network automation tools AutoPilot and Dynamic CX, focused on real-time resilience. AutoPilot uses AI to automate network configuration and traffic routing during disruptions and periods of heavy demand. Dynamic CX applies AI to monitor service quality and adjust network resources to support customer experience during high-usage events. The rollout of AutoPilot and Dynamic CX comes amid broader shifts in telecom AI infrastructure...
